title: Devin's independently derived MSP expectation ledger (pre-migration)
author: Devin, rehearsal session https://app.devin.ai/sessions/227ede5941704863b4c28458ebdba9ff
derivation: Every expected result below was worked out by hand from CMS Pub. 100-05 Ch. 5 sections 40.8-40.8.3 (policy cases) or from the documented demo interface contract in README.md (interface cases). No value was copied from COBOL output or from fixtures/expected.json. Amounts are integer cents. Symbols: C covered charges, G gross Medicare payable, P primary payment, D deductible, K coinsurance, T = D + K, A optional obligatory acceptance amount (OTAF), B = A if supplied else C. Policy: payment = max(0, min(G-P, G-T, B-P, B-T)) unless the primary payment was accepted as payment in full (full=Y), in which case 0.
source: CMS Medicare Secondary Payer Manual, Pub. 100-05, Chapter 5, https://www.cms.gov/Regulations-and-Guidance/Guidance/Manuals/Downloads/msp105c05.pdf (retrieved PDF SHA-256 a2ea49af2675c75ee617961723848016fee55f80b74aa7716b22fa38e10af693; one-based PDF pages)
interface_assumptions: I1 Zero-reason precedence (PAYMENT_IN_FULL, then PRIMARY_AT_CAP, then DEDUCTIONS_AT_CAP) and all reason/status strings are demo interface codes, not CMS codes.
I2 PRIMARY_AT_CAP means P >= min(G, B); DEDUCTIONS_AT_CAP means T >= min(G, B) with P below it. A zero cap therefore reports PRIMARY_AT_CAP.
I3 A supplied contract equal to charges is valid; a contract above charges is BAD_CONTRACT; a contract of zero is valid and gives a zero cap.
I4 Validation order: BAD_LENGTH, BAD_ID, BAD_AMOUNT, BAD_CONTRACT, BAD_FLAG. BAD_LENGTH/BAD_ID rows use identity @ + 10-digit record number; later rejections keep the claim ID.
I5 Each record is evaluated independently; nothing parsed from an earlier (even rejected) record may affect a later one.
I6 Duplicate identifiable IDs, lines over 4096 bytes, more than 10000 records, wrong argument count and identical paths are fatal (exit 2). Empty input is a valid zero-record batch.
I7 Upstream supplies eligibility, coverage, G, D and K; the historical $1,556 deductible appears only as example input.

I9 CWF step (CMS Pub. 100-04 Ch. 27 s20, s20.2.2): only valid claims (PAID or ZERO) are sent; first failure wins: NOT_ENTITLED, DUPLICATE, MSP_PRIMARY_NOT_BILLED; else ACCEPTED/DISPOSITION_01. Reject codes are demo codes.
I10 Entitlement and MSP periods are inclusive of both end dates; 99999999 means open-ended.
I11 DUPLICATE means CWF history already holds the same MBI, service date and charges; claims in one batch are not compared with each other.
I12 MSP_PRIMARY_NOT_BILLED means an MSP period covers the service date and the claim's primary payment is exactly 0, regardless of the full flag.
I13 released_cents equals payment_cents when ACCEPTED and 0 otherwise; payment_cents still shows what was calculated.

I14 New validation after the flag: MBI (positions 74-84) must be 11 of A-Z/0-9 (BAD_MBI); service date (85-92) must be 8 digits with month 01-12 and day 01-31 (BAD_DATE). Invalid claims are NOT_SENT/CLAIM_INVALID.
